title: First Impression: Mini Dashboard Sprites for Console Onboarding
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact set of dashboard 'mini-sprites' (static + micro-animated variants) used across the first-run onboarding tour: checklist tiles, empty-state illustrations, contextual tip badges, and compact product screenshots. These assets should be visually cohesive with the console brand, optimized for small real estate (40–160px), and export-ready for web (SVG/PNG) and Lottie fallback where micro-animation is used.
acceptance_criteria: Set of 12 unique sprite motifs covering: checklist, welcome, dataset empty state, model empty state, cost tip, latency tip, badge-success, badge-warning, quickstart-tile, onboarding-hint, screenshot-compact, spinner-micro
Each sprite exported in SVG + 2 PNG densities (1x, 2x) and a single Lottie JSON for the 4 micro-animated variants
Design spec sheet with pixel grid, safe padding, color tokens, and accessible contrast ratios published to Figma and Confluence
Handoff tokens and export naming convention documented in the assets folder and verified with frontend (ENG-20021) using sample import PR
QA checklist validated on Chrome, Firefox, and Safari at 320px, 768px, and 1280px widths
review_feedback: Priya Nair (PM): Prefer single color token for notification badges to reduce cognitive load — ok to use accent-500 for positive and warning-400 for cautions
Noah Kim (Eng): Prefer SVGs with limited filters; suggested swapping complex shadows for 1px stroke to keep bundle size low
Sofia Alvarez (Design Lead): Approve overall visual direction; asked to provide a 'low-fidelity' sprite set for A/B testing before shipping micro-animations
tasks: Sketch 18 motif ideas and narrow to 12 (Maya)
Create responsive variants (40px, 80px, 160px) and grid-aligned exports (Ethan)
Produce Lottie micro-animations for 4 prioritized motifs (contractor -> handoff)
Write spec and export naming guidelines (Maya + Ethan)
Open asset import PR and coordinate with ENG-20021 for auto-build test
notes: 2026-03-01: Kickoff — aligned with PM on scope; decided to keep set compact (<=12) to avoid cognitive overhead during first-run
2026-03-02: Early sketches reviewed — narrowed to 15 motifs; removed overly literal server rack illustration due to visual noise
2026-03-03: Feasibility sync with Eng (Noah) — agreed on SVG-first strategy; discussed PNG fallbacks for legacy embed contexts
2026-03-04: Design critique — Sofia requested low-fidelity variants for rapid A/B; prioritized 4 micro-animated motifs for engagement testing (checklist, welcome, spinner, badge-success)

2026-03-05: Export pipeline prototyped — created naming convention 'onb_{motif}_{size}_{variant}.svg/png' and sample PR opened (see PR links). Next: finalize palette tokens and produce Lottie exports.
